OUR MISSION

To improve healthcare by giving providers timely access to pharmaceutical, medical and surgical products that support patient health and wellness.

ABOUT SKY HEALTHCARE

A distribution partner built around access

Sky Healthcare Limited was established in 2007 by pharmaceutical professionals. The company works with manufacturers, healthcare providers, pharmacies and patients to support reliable access to essential medicines and healthcare products.

Its operating model brings distribution, inventory control, secure storage and delivery together in one healthcare supply chain.

OUR SERVICES

Seven capabilities across the distribution cycle

Each capability supports product integrity, availability and timely delivery.

01

Pharmaceutical distribution

Branded, branded-generic, generic and specialty medicines supplied across the healthcare market.

02

Last-mile coverage

A channel network designed to reach pharmacies, clinics and hospitals in smaller towns and remote areas.

03

Secure warehousing

Organized storage with temperature and humidity monitoring to support safe product handling.

04

Inventory management

Systems that support appropriate stock levels and help reduce shortages and wastage.

05

Cold-chain logistics

A temperature-controlled cold room with 24-hour power backup for sensitive pharmaceutical products.

06

Order fulfilment

A stated order-to-invoice-and-dispatch response time of under 90 minutes, with urgent orders prioritized.

07

Regulatory compliance

Distribution activities aligned with local regulatory requirements and WHO-recommended standards.

LAST-MILE ACCESS

Extending supply beyond major centers

Sky mapped registered pharmacies and mid-sized hospitals, including mission hospitals in remote areas, to understand supply gaps and purchasing challenges.

The resulting model supports regional pharmacies and wholesalers that can serve nearby retail pharmacies and small clinics efficiently.
